specification: IMAGE MEMORY-OBJECTS: three separate, equally clear pictures: a plain drinking cup, a door key, and an apple. No printed labels while visible. Provide equivalent spoken descriptions for nonvisual use.
CONTROL: Show pictures → Hide pictures → spoken or typed attempt → Reveal pictures. No timer. Reveal is also available after “I cannot recall yet”.

IMAGE MEMORY-SHAPES: unlabelled triangle outline; response shapes circle, triangle, square. Accessible labels identify the three shapes. For nonvisual use, prompt “Which of these shapes has three sides?”
AUDIO MNTL-M: isolated /m/; AUDIO MNTL-N: isolated /n/. Play on request, without adding a vowel.
IMAGE MNTL-M and MNTL-N: Guy’s original mountain-climber and nose mnemonic drawings, paired with the exact block letters.
AUDIO MNTL-T: isolated /t/; AUDIO MNTL-L: isolated /l/.
IMAGE MNTL-T and MNTL-L: Guy’s original tripping and ladle drawings. Preserve the source drawing rather than substituting a new mnemonic.
KEYBOARD: highlight the matching key only during copying. Hide the highlight for recall questions.
HIGHLIGHT WRITING-DIRECTION: mark the rightmost מ first, then נ, ת and ל. Step through on taps; retain an arrow pointing left. Treat מנתל as a practice string with no assigned meaning.
POSITION DIAGRAM: show מ in the first slot of a three-slot RTL word, then ם in the final slot. The slots are boxes, not additional letters.
OPTIONAL DOWNLOAD WRITING-SCRIPT: Guy’s handwriting sheet for the taught letters only; link pending. Do not display a broken download button before the asset is supplied.
AUDIO VOWELS-MA, VOWELS-ME, VOWELS-MI: /ma/, /me/, /mi/, one separate recording each. The English sound labels are approximations; the native model is the target.
AUDIO VOWELS-A-PAIR: מַ, מָ, each /ma/. Display both pointed forms.
AUDIO VOWELS-N-SET: separate /na/, /ne/, /ni/ recordings.
AUDIO VOWELS-STRING: /ma-ni-la/. Reveal only after the learner’s first spoken attempt.
IMAGE AHY-ALEF: Guy’s original albatross/eagle mnemonic paired with א.
AUDIO AHY-IMA: אמא, mother. IMAGE AHY-MOTHER: a clearly captioned English scenario “a child’s mother”; do not expect appearance alone to establish the relationship.
IMAGE AHY-HEH: original throat mnemonic. AUDIO AHY-H: isolated /h/. AUDIO AHY-MATANA: מתנה.
IMAGE AHY-GIFT: wrapped present being offered; alt description “a gift”.
IMAGE AHY-YOD: original itsy-bitsy mnemonic. AUDIO AHY-YAM, AHY-MAYIM, AHY-YAYIN: sea, water and wine, separately.
IMAGES AHY-SEA, AHY-WATER, AHY-WINE: coastline; water being poured into a glass; clearly labelled wine bottle beside a glass. Wine must not be identifiable merely by liquid colour.
IMAGE AHY-PORTION: one plated serving of food. AUDIO AHY-MANA: מנה.

AUDIO NOMINAL-TAMI-INTRO: היי, אני תמי. אני מנהלת.

specification: AUDIO QUESTIONS-ATA and QUESTIONS-AT: אתה; את. AUDIO QUESTIONS-STATEMENTS: אתה מתן; את תמי.
CHARACTERS: identify the addressee explicitly as one man named Matan or one woman named Tami.
AUDIO QUESTIONS-WHO: מי אתה? מי את? מי את? — אני תמי. Use distinct speakers for the exchange.
AUDIO QUESTIONS-ATEM and QUESTIONS-ATEN; AUDIO QUESTIONS-GROUP: מי אתם? — אני מתן. — אני תמי.

AUDIO QUESTIONS-CLARIFY: אני תמי. — מה? — תמי. A brief, friendly clarification exchange.

AUDIO VAV-FRUIT: תאנה או תות? — תות. Model the whole exchange.

AUDIO VAV-HE-SHE: הוא; היא; מי הוא? — הוא מתן; מי היא? — היא תמי.

SOUND VAV-MUSICAL-NOTE: one pitched note. IMAGE VAV-LETTER: printed מ. The musical note must not be confused with a recording of spoken Hebrew.
